_help: Linux/macOS counterpart of ico-preview.windows.json, using netpng's ico2png (github.com/tsnomura/netpng — cargo build or its install.sh; headless and cross-platform, so no path placeholder is needed as long as ico2png is on PATH). Extracts the largest size in the icon as PNG, including the PNG-compressed 256px entries that index-based extractors (icotool -i 0) can't be trusted to pick — an earlier icotool-based Linux example was dropped as untested, this one is verified on Linux. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
